name: Swift 6.3.1 Release
body:
- Install via Swiftly `swiftly install 6.3.1`
- WinGet Support will be available soon ([PR](https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs/pull/361727))
- Docker images will be available on [hub.docker.com/_/swift](http://hub.docker.com/_/swift) soon. ([PR](https://github.com/docker-library/official-images/pull/21263))
- Forums post: https://forums.swift.org/t/announcing-swift-6-3-1/86080

name: Swift 3.0.1 Preview 3
body:

https://github.com/apple/swift-llvm

https://github.com/apple/swift-corelibs-foundation

https://github.com/apple/swift-package-manager
https://github.com/apple/swift-cmark
https://github.com/apple/swift-integration-tests

Building this preview on macOS requires [Xcode 8.1 beta 3](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/download).
